dedupe_keys.name: borehole design charts for buried waste bodies simulation data and code

description: András Mahler publishes Python simulation code and derived design tables for finding buried waste bodies using boreholes. The August 2026 deposit compares random, square, triangular and stratified sampling layouts for detection, confirmation and delineation. Its site layer uses 136 borehole positions, including nine waste-positive observations, digitised from figures of a published industrial-site investigation. CSV summaries, configurations and a runnable ZIP source tree are freely available under CC BY 4.0. The code requires Python 3.12 with NumPy, SciPy, pandas and Matplotlib. It can test investigation-density choices for waste-site assessment. The README flags uncertain digitised geometry and strong sensitivity to the assumed investigation boundary. Required densities beyond the simulated range are lower bounds. Per-replication arrays are omitted but seeds are supplied for regeneration. No related catalogue record covers this model. Code execution was not checked; the describing manuscript is identified as submitted.
